Self.Wiki: Fall prevention wall removal area: a marker for the offline map build. Inside it, the automatically generated fall-prevention walls along ledges are left out (vanilla names: 落下防止壁削除, and 落下防止壁生成禁止, "fall-prevention wall generation forbidden"), so that drop-offs such as stair gaps, beams and cliff descents stay passable. The game never reads it, so editing it changes nothing in-game. 56 regions in retail, all boxes.
